name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 6 visits over 50 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2026-07-10, at wavelengths from 0.81 to 4.66 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
